description: Nineteen-body NEXUS NM heavy-duty mecanum-wheel reconstruction with two mostly closed circular side plates, one stepped eight-bolt hub, eight STEP-profiled barrel rollers captured by integrated rim mounting seats, eight coaxial pins, and left/right handedness defined by one consistent mirrored 45-degree skew.
source: NEXUS Robot official NM127A, NM152A, NM203A, NM254A, and NM305A dimensioned PDFs and official STEP ZIPs; STEP files are measurement evidence only and are not imported; undimensioned external details are documented proportions
